limitations: Two fresh training seeds share 222 validation queries; 666 observations are not 666 independent examples.
Seed 1729 is reused historical development/selection evidence, not a fresh replication.
Architecture/objective/scorer are unchanged; evaluator binds matching-seed floors and conjunction.
Dense validation does not establish autoregressive generation, serving or protected-test quality.
Terminal chronology is an owner observation bound by receipts, not independent execution replay.
Local checkpoint hashes do not establish durable remote weight archival.
